name: @puggietype/desktop
description: PuggieType desktop shell (Steam flavor). Plain Electron, no Steamworks SDK, no ads.

scripts.dist:linux:dev: node scripts/package.mjs --dev && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never --linux dir AppImage --x64 && node scripts/check-installer.mjs dist-installers/linux-unpacked
scripts.dist:win:dev: node scripts/package.mjs --dev && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never --win nsis dir --x64 && node scripts/check-installer.mjs dist-installers/win-unpacked
scripts.dist:mac:dev: node scripts/package.mjs --dev && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never --mac dmg dir --x64 --arm64 && node scripts/check-installer.mjs dist-installers/mac dist-installers/mac-arm64
